tools.name: find_species
tools.description: Find species of India by Latin name or English common name (any word of it, from its start: "great indian bustard", "naja", "cobra"). Returns up to 10 species with their key for get_species, group, IUCN category and status.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: One species of India by its key (from find_species or list_species): sources that list it, open record, states with an open record, WII regions, IUCN category with the year, DOI and trend of the assessment, endemic, year described and authority, family and order, evidence (type specimens, photos, DN

tools.name: count_species
tools.description: How many species of India: documented, with an open record, threatened (IUCN CR, EN, VU), recorded in the last 10 years, endemic, and per IUCN category. All filters are optional and combine: "how many butterflies in India", "threatened birds in Kerala", "endemic frogs of the Western Ghats".

tools.name: list_species
tools.description: List species of India with optional filters that combine: "critically endangered species in India", "endangered animals in Karnataka", "snakes of the Western Ghats", "birds of Goa recorded since 2020". Rows by group, then Latin name; up to 100 per page, with the total and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: new_species
tools.description: Species described from India since a year (2007 or later), from Plazi, the BSI Plant Discoveries and the ZSI Animal Discoveries: the year, the group, the state of the type locality, the journal and a link to the paper, and whether it has been recorded since.
